title: Command
description: One player action. Must survive a JSON round trip: no object references, no class instances, no undefined. Appended to the IndexedDB command log at issue time; the log is the save.

actor.description: Issuing station. 'local' in single-player. Present from day one so Phase 9 needs no retrofit.

canonical.description: Human-readable canonical form. Powers the command line, voice control, and the scriptable test harness.

issuedAt.description: Proper (crew) time in seconds since scenario epoch.

sequence.description: Monotonic. Defines log ordering and reconciliation.
